name: Slides
description: A slide deck with themes, editable inline, and a presenter mode everyone follows live. The agent drafts and edits the deck through its API.
headline: What's this deck *about*?
intro: Your deck is open on the right. The agent edits it live through the deck's API — slides, layouts, themes, speaker notes — and can present it to everyone watching.

suggestions.p: Draft this deck for my Q3 planning meeting: goals, risks, timeline, asks. 6–8 slides.
Look at the deck, pick the theme that suits its content best, and tighten the layouts slide by slide.
Write concise speaker notes for every slide in this deck.
Cut this deck down to 5 slides at most, keeping only the strongest points.
Turn the attached document into slides in this deck.
Take a screenshot of this deck, critique it like a design reviewer, then fix the top three issues.
